recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed unless future publisher output regresses and stops rendering the triple-bracket resource link in the request-intent expansion.
issue_request: FHIR-27127 was a Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction reporting incorrect markup for a resource link in the request-intent value set expansion at valueset-request-intent.html.
initial_application: No FHIR-27127-tagged source commit was found. The authoritative request pattern source already used FHIR triple-bracket resource-link markup before the Jira was filed, and the 2021 source split preserved that markup in codesystem-request-intent.xml, indicating the original defect was likely in generated rendering rather than checked-in terminology source.
additional_context: FHIR-24619 later renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration, and commit 46bea37a00e63d1ace04a5f322614c6d0815f500 updated the same request-intent option definition while preserving triple-bracket link markup. The request logical pattern and the RequestOrchestration/ServiceRequest resources are active in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/request/codesystem-request-intent.xml and source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml already contain [[[RequestOrchestration]]], and both build.fhir.org plus the R5 published value set expansion render RequestOrchestration as a hyperlink.
